profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary:
I am currently a Software Engineer at Amazon, helping build tools to automate networking processes at fulfillment centers. I'm interested in building cloud native solutions, writing and designing scalable systems, and automation.

In my spare time I look for hobbies that challenge me. These have included rock climbing, volleyball, and glass blowing.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.insights: System Architecture, Risk Management and +3 skills

positions.title: Master
positions.description: As a master, I acted as a leader and mentor to students on all other teams at the Digital Corps. I assisted in developing the company culture and social activities, finding ways to encourage innovation in the new remote setting. The other masters and I collaborated on ways to onboard and train new employees. I am also in charge of managing projects, developing deadlines, and interacting with clients. I automated the deployments of our cloud infrastructure, enabling us to shift to continuously deployed serverless development.

positions.title: Development Specialist
positions.description:
Projects:
Innovate Within
- Implementing security features for the largest high school pitch competition in the country [Slim]
- Adding usability enhancements to the user-facing, and admin-facing sites [React]

Touch Table
- Researched new ways to interact with users

Writing Challenge
- Designed backend for managing users' writing information, team membership, and historical data [Slim, MySQL]
- Wrote MySQL procedures to award users and teams achievements for meeting certain goals
- Added features to React frontend

Roles:
- Helping to lead and guide new hires at the Digital Corps

- Offer advice that pertains to my expertise in API development

- Give and assist in presentations to the development team to foster growth

positions.title: Development Apprentice
positions.description:
As an apprentice developer at the Digital Corps I was trained in backend and frontend technologies and worked with a multi-disciplined team who worked in user-experience, video production, design, and communication to provide the best solutions to clients needs. 

My projects have included:

- Building a REST API fora 2-year task completion program [Slim, MySQL]

- Adding features to a legacy project used in the hiring process [Angular 1.0, Slim]. These included: 
    ~Making the open and closed periods of the site database driven and controlled by the admin panel
    ~Various UI changes
    ~Improving the existing slack integration and allowing creating a debug mode that could be toggled in the admin panel to keep channels from receiving messages about test applicants

- Weekly soft skills trainings designed to help me transition into the professional workforce

positions.title: Software Dev Engineer Intern
positions.description:
I built a generic notification service used to reduce the mean time to resolution of issues regarding fulfillment center’s networking devices/configuration and automation. I collected customer requirements, designed my software, implemented, built a continuous deployment pipeline, and completed a security review. It was already being used in production before I left.

I made other contributions as well: reviewing my teammates code, fixing bugs in some of our dependencies, and adding custom metric collection to one our new services. 

Languages used: Kotlin, Python, Typescript

Cloud technologies used: AWS SDK, Lambda, API Gateway, SES, AWS CDK, CloudWatch, Event Rules, DynamoDB, SecretsManager, AWS KMS

positions.title: Programming Consultant
positions.description:
I maintained software solutions and addressed clients' questions. Some of my projects included:
- Adding features to payment portal to allow customers to sign up for recurring billing and switch their plan [Laravel]

- Designing, developing, and deploying a custom survey site to access individuals strengths [Laravel, Oracle]

- Upgrading a webhooks API to reduce code duplication and allow for scaling of features [PHP]
    ~ Automated the process of throttling internet speeds based on account payment status
    ~ Subscribed to tv services dynamically on sign-up
    ~ Activate fiber devices automatically on install

- Making a twenty-year old e-commerce site PCI compliant by integrating a modern payment processor and migrating the PHP 4 codebase to PHP 7.4

- Improved load times of 45 Joomla sites by 50% by overseeing the migration to a modern Ubuntu server

- Building a custom invoice system for a VoIP reseller [Laravel]

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
At Solutions4ebiz I have worked on a variety of projects and remain flexible, learning new frameworks or software as needed to do my job. I have:

- Created a timesheet application that replaced 19 year old software [Laravel]

- Automated and oversaw the data transfer between CRMs preserving the existing relationships between accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities [PHP, MySQL]

- Refactored existing software, removing over 1,000 lines of code while improving readability [PHP]

- Added SSL certificates to sites and automated their renewal with a cronjob [Linux]

- Integrated 3 separate WISP services via webhooks and a custom API to sync IP assignments, payment statuses, and rate plans [PHP]

honors.title: Best in Show -Code Quality
honors.description:
I wrote a random image manipulator in python for one of my CS classes. It could take any image, pick a random orientation and layout (e.g. 3 rows by 4 columns of the image repeating), dynamically resize the image to fit inside the specifications and apply random edits to each repeat of the image on the canvas. 
A resulting image was chosen and put in an art show with the other classes. Mine was picked for best code quality.
honors.issuer: Issued by Professor David Largent · Nov 2018

honors.title: Valedictorian
honors.issuer: Issued by Lapel High School · Jun 2018
